authorizedProduct.providerFeeCents: must be read from the captured provider transaction

implementation.scope: Opt in the owned test store without changing other merchants or reinterpreting already-created payment intents.
implementation.capture: Stripe platform-owned payment, with no immediate destination transfer or application fee. Preserve the existing secure widget and payment intent lifecycle.
implementation.allocation: Freeze buyer fee, merchant fee, recipient, account identity and window before provider creation. Read actual provider fees and conserve every cent across platform, merchant and provider.
implementation.retention: Reuse payment holds and the existing Stripe marketplace capture/transfer verification. A planned entry is not provider confirmation. Schedule only after the configured return window and payout delay, and never before provider availability.
implementation.payout: Persist a single submission and stable reference before remote mutation. Reconcile uncertain results by GET. Require an exact provider receipt before marking release; refuse refunded, disputed, foreign or insufficient captures.
implementation.rails: Stripe card first. Keep existing connections; do not advertise Mercado Pago Pix as retained without its commercial capture/transfer contract.
implementation.activation: Local tests, persisted sandbox validation, provider eligibility and bank payout reserve checks must pass before enabling the owned store for the two real payments.

validation.paidOrders: customer action required after retention is ready
checks: real charge approval and persisted order
bank payout distinct from platform-to-merchant transfer
